metrics.gotcha: Status values are PascalCase in VSPC v5: 'Warning', 'Failed', 'Success'. Note operator precedence in this JMESPath: the || binds loosely, so `isEnabled==true && status==Warning || status==Failed` evaluates as `(isEnabled==true && status==Warning) || status==Failed`. This may include disabled jobs with 'Failed' status. Matches the exact Global metric query.
